An '''arcade''' was located in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. In order to attracts potential customers, [[Aurebesh]] signs of various [[color]]s spelling out the word "arcade" were put up on the streets, although a couple of letters were missing from a purple sign over the entrance.<ref name="Kenobi" />
